title: Deployment go-live retry UX and no-infinite-loading safeguards

requirements.summary: Prevent infinite “going live/connecting” states by adding a user-confirmed retry action and clear failure UI when the production go-live attempt stalls or fails.
acceptanceCriteria: A new production go-live/push attempt is triggered after the user confirms.
The production deployment completes successfully and no longer remains stuck on “going live”/endless loading.
If the retry fails, the user is shown a clear failure outcome (error or status) instead of indefinite loading.

file_operations.description: Add a bounded initialization strategy to avoid indefinite loading (e.g., wrap actor creation/initialization in a timeout that fails fast), and expose additional hook state for the UI (e.g., actorInitError details and a retry function that re-triggers actor initialization). Ensure retry clears/refreshes relevant cached state so a new attempt actually occurs.

Create a reusable UI component that communicates a stalled/failed go-live or backend connection state and provides a user-confirmed “Retry go-live” action plus a clear failure outcome if retries keep failing. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card/Alert/Button and optionally AlertDialog for confirmation) to present status and confirmation; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace the current potentially endless “Connecting...” experience with: (1) a time-bounded connecting phase driven by the updated useActor() state, (2) a clear error/status block when initialization times out/fails, and (3) a visible, user-confirmed retry action by rendering the new GoLiveRetryCard component. Ensure all user-facing text is in English and that failure states do not leave the UI in indefinite loading. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire any global retry/status UI requirements if needed (e.g., ensure the page(s) that can show the stuck “going live” state render the retry experience consistently). Keep routing intact and avoid unrelated UI/logic changes; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
